results.text: Long-Term Efficacy and Safety of Denosumab: Insights beyond 10 Years of Use. Osteoporosis management in post-menopausal women focuses on fracture prevention, with denosumab as a key therapeutic option. Despite its proven efficacy in reducing fracture risk and increasing bone mineral density (BMD) over 10 years, its long-term impact remains uncertain.
